subject: How do I include more objective functions in my TMB .cpp

messages.author: 67573fb6b406e2fa
messages.subject: How do I include more objective functions in my TMB .cpp
parts:
Hi all, I am probably asking an easy question. I want to include several likelihood functions in the TMB cpp file to later include that in an  R package. So far the compilation of the file failed. Of course when I separate the likelihoods everything work. From my understanding when compiling a package with cpp files only one DLL is created therefore I wonder how MakeADFun differentiates them when the structure is almost the same.
I have tried several things but the compilation of the file did not work.
I attach an example of my TMB file with two likelihood functions.

Thanks

Best

messages.author: 67573fb6b406e2fa
messages.subject: Re: How do I include more objective functions in my TMB .cpp
parts:
I have actually figured it out overnight. Basically I created a model.hpp for each model which is then called in the TMB.cpp file. All is explained here: https://github.com/mlysy/TMBtools

Best
